_note: Batch 27 hub bands (the design notes section 3). Bots within radius tiles of x,y (plane 0) are counted every 10 min. Day band dayMin-dayMax, evening (23:00-04:00 UTC) eveMin-eveMax. A hub with no band fields is counted only. Shipped default: copied to data/eco/hubs.json on first boot; edit that copy. A hub may give its own breakRange (breaks within that many tiles go there while it is under; batch 27 fix 3, only with -Dhubs.breaks=true). Lumbridge-only rescope (the design notes section 4): only Lumbridge is banded, the other hubs are counted only. Off: -Dhubs=false or the file data/hubs.off. Train-4 thermostat (-Dhubs.thermostat=true, off by default): a hub arms at the edge of its band after thermostatWindows censuses (1) and holds until the count reaches the band's middle; the first census after boot arms nothing; underWindows is the old rule's delay and is not read with the flag on.
